```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r}
polyclonal_env <- new.env()
load("../../../Data/Processed/PolyclonalCultures/DNAm/all_results_betas_IM_nonIM_with_healthy_annotated.RData", envir = polyclonal_env)
all_res_beta_pc <- get("all_results_betas_annotated", polyclonal_env)
clonal_env <- new.env()
load("../../../Data/Processed/ClonalCultures/DNAm/all_results_betas_IM_nonIM_with_healthy_annotated.RData", envir = clonal_env)
all_res_beta_cl <- get("all_results_betas_annotated", clonal_env)
```

```{r}
res_pc <- all_res_beta_pc[["IMvsNormalAntrum"]]
res_cl <- all_res_beta_cl[["IMvsNormalAntrum"]]
```


```{r}
if(F) {
  all_results_beta_annotated_wgs <- readRDS("../../../Data/ExtData/Other_Methylation_data/GSE186458_WGBS_Atlas/Analysis/WGS_gut_DM.rds")
  
  # wgs_sig <- lapply(all_results_beta_annotated_wgs, function(x) {
  #   x <- subset(x, adj.P.Val < 0.05 & abs(logFC) > 0.2)
  #   x$direction <- ifelse(x$logFC > 0.2, "hyper", "hypo")
  #   return(x)
  # })
  
  wgs_all_ilmn <- lapply(all_results_beta_annotated_wgs, function(x) {
    x <- subset(x, !is.na(ilmn_id))
    x$dge_class <- ifelse(x$adj.P.Val > 0.05, "ns", ifelse(x$logFC > 0, ifelse(x$logFC > 0.2, "hyper", "hyper_weak"), ifelse(x$logFC < -0.2, "hypo", "hypo_weak")))
    x$direction <- ifelse(x$adj.P.Val > 0.05, "ns", ifelse(abs(x$logFC) < 0.2, "nc/weak", ifelse(x$logFC > 0.2, "hyper", "hypo")))
    return(x)
  })
  
  saveRDS(wgs_all_ilmn, file="../../../Data/ExtData/Other_Methylation_data/GSE186458_WGBS_Atlas/Analysis/WGS_gut_DM_EPIC_only.rds", compress=T)
} else {
  wgs_all_ilmn <- readRDS(file="../../../Data/ExtData/Other_Methylation_data/GSE186458_WGBS_Atlas/Analysis/WGS_gut_DM_EPIC_only.rds")
}
```


```{r}
wgs_corpus_vs_antrum <- wgs_all_ilmn$StoCorpus_vs_StoAntrum[, c("ilmn_id","dge_class","direction")]
colnames(wgs_corpus_vs_antrum) <- c("ilmn_id","wgbs_corpus_vs_antrum_dge_class", "wgbs_corpus_vs_antrum_direction")

res_cl <- merge(res_cl, wgs_corpus_vs_antrum, by.x="Row.names", by.y="ilmn_id", all.x=T, sort=F)
res_pc <- merge(res_pc, wgs_corpus_vs_antrum, by.x="Row.names", by.y="ilmn_id", all.x=T, sort=F)

```



```{r}
sel_cols_cl <- c("Row.names","logFC","AveExpr","t","P.Value","adj.P.Val","B")
sel_cols_pc <- c("Row.names","logFC","AveExpr","t","P.Value","adj.P.Val","B","UCSC_RefGene_Name","UCSC_RefGene_Accession","UCSC_RefGene_Group","Phantom5_Enhancers","DMR","X450k_Enhancer","Regulatory_Feature_Group","GencodeCompV12_NAME","GencodeCompV12_Accession","GencodeCompV12_Group","DNase_Hypersensitivity_NAME","DNase_Hypersensitivity_Evidence_Count","OpenChromatin_NAME","OpenChromatin_Evidence_Count","TFBS_NAME","TFBS_Evidence_Count","Colon_vs_StoAntrum","SI_vs_StoAntrum","Antrum_EPIC","Corpus_EPIC","Colon.Left_WGS","Colon.Right_WGS","Gastric.antrum_WGS","Gastric.body_WGS","Gastric.fundus_WGS","Small.int_WGS","wgbs_corpus_vs_antrum_dge_class", "wgbs_corpus_vs_antrum_direction")
res_comb <- merge(res_cl[, sel_cols_cl], res_pc[, sel_cols_pc], by="Row.names", sort=F)
colnames(res_comb) <- gsub("\\.y", "_polyclonal", gsub("\\.x", "_clonal", colnames(res_comb)) )
```

# General correlation

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
plot(res_comb$logFC_clonal, res_comb$logFC_polyclonal, pch=20, col=rgb(0,0,0,0.2), main="All probes", xlab="diff beta clonal", ylab="diff beta polyclonal")
sig_any <- subset(res_comb, adj.P.Val_clonal < 0.05 | adj.P.Val_polyclonal < 0.05)
with(sig_any, plot(logFC_clonal, logFC_polyclonal, pch=20, col=rgb(0,0,0,0.2), main="Significantly DM probes", xlab="diff beta clonal", ylab="diff beta polyclonal"))
abline(h=0, v=0, lty=2)
```

# Concordant DM probes

```{r}
concording_res <- subset(res_comb, (sign(logFC_clonal) * sign(logFC_polyclonal)) > 0 & adj.P.Val_clonal < 0.05 & adj.P.Val_polyclonal < 0.05)
cat("Total concordant probes")
nrow(concording_res)

table(ifelse(sign(concording_res$logFC_clonal) > 0, "Hypermethylated","Hypomethylated"))
```


```{r}

table(concording_res$Colon_vs_StoAntrum, ifelse(sign(concording_res$logFC_clonal)==1, "Hypermethylated", "Hypomethylated"), dnn=c("Colon_vs_Stomach","IM_vs_Antrum") )

table(concording_res$SI_vs_StoAntrum, ifelse(sign(concording_res$logFC_clonal)==1, "Hypermethylated", "Hypomethylated"), dnn=c("SI_vs_Stomach","IM_vs_Antrum") )

table(concording_res$Antrum_EPIC, ifelse(sign(concording_res$logFC_clonal)==1, "Hypermethylated", "Hypomethylated"), dnn=c("U.M class Antrum EPIC","IM_vs_Antrum") )

table(concording_res$wgbs_corpus_vs_antrum_direction, ifelse(sign(concording_res$logFC_clonal)==1, "Hypermethylated", "Hypomethylated"), dnn=c("DGE class WGS Corpus vs. Antrum","IM_vs_Antrum"), useNA="always" )
```

# TFs

```{r}
tf <- read.table("~/Work/References/pyscenic/hs_hgnc_tfs.txt", sep="\t", header=F)
```


```{r}
candidates_hyper <- subset(concording_res, Antrum_EPIC=="uu" & Colon_vs_StoAntrum =="hyper" & logFC_clonal > 0)

hyper_genes <- strsplit(candidates_hyper$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";") |> sapply(unique)
candidates_hyper$gene_symbols <- sapply(hyper_genes, paste, collapse=",")
candidates_hyper$is_TF <- sapply(hyper_genes, function(x) any(match(tf$V1, x)))

candidates_hypo <- subset(concording_res, Antrum_EPIC=="mm" & Colon_vs_StoAntrum =="hypo" & logFC_clonal < 0)
hypo_genes <- strsplit(candidates_hypo$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";") |> sapply(unique)
candidates_hypo$gene_symbols <- sapply(hypo_genes, paste, collapse=",")
candidates_hypo$is_TF <- sapply(hypo_genes, function(x) any(match(tf$V1, x)))


```


## TFs, hyperm.

```{r}
tf_hyper <- subset(candidates_hyper, is_TF)$gene_symbols |> table() |> sort()
tf_hyper
```


## TF activitiy overlap from PySCENIC

```{r, fig.height=9}
load("../../../Data/ExtData/Zhang_scRNA/PySCENIC_with_GCA_downsampled/TF_DE_selected_comparisons.Rdata")

tf_hyper_pyscenic_ovlp <- subset(dge_results_all, GeneSymbol %in% names(tf_hyper))

ggplot(tf_hyper_pyscenic_ovlp) + geom_bar(stat="identity", aes(x=celltype, y=avg_difference)) + facet_wrap(~GeneSymbol, scales = "free_x") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1)) + ggtitle("hypermethylated genes") + labs(y="PySCENIC TF activity difference")
```
